plan.title: bug(telemetry,verify-ac): acceptance events absent in field streams - stamp emission bound solely to issue:ingest; verify:ac emitted no outcome events across fail AND pass paths in a real trial

narratives.Description: acceptance_stamp emits only from issue:ingest, so hand-authored consumer briefs never stamp. The product AC gate produced no acceptance outcome events on either fail or pass paths in a real trial.
narratives.Overview:
**TL;DR: acceptance telemetry is unreliable in the field. `acceptance_stamp` emits from exactly one call site — the issue-ingest intake verb — which consumer/headless flows that hand-author scope briefs never call. `acceptance` outcome events emitted zero times across a full real trial that exercised the product AC gate on BOTH its fail path (issue 3334 refusal, exit 2) and its pass path (exit 0, twice). The #3323 clause/rung telemetry is therefore invisible exactly where it matters.**

**Evidence (internal benchmark artifacts, private):** one complete trial's `DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH` stream (framework 0.102.0, 7 lines) contains session_start, dial_escalation_evaluation, and check_invocation events — and no acceptance events of either kind, despite the trial hand-authoring a brief, tripping the #3334 empty-acceptance refusal, stamping `plan.acceptance` mid-run, and passing the product AC gate twice. Source at HEAD: emitAcceptanceStamp is called only from packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts; emitAcceptanceOutcome call sites exist in product-first-done-gate/evaluate.ts but produced nothing on this trial — trace why (early-return paths, emitter wiring in the gate subprocess, or env propagation).

## Fix
1. Stamp emission becomes state-observed, not verb-bound: whenever plan.acceptance is first written or materially changed through any lifecycle verb (promote/activate/verify), emit acceptance_stamp from the observed state.
2. The product AC gate emits an acceptance outcome event on EVERY terminal path — config-error, soft-missing, soft-empty, run-pass, run-fail — so the stream distinguishes them (composes #3334 visibility).
3. Test fixture: a trial-shaped integration test (hand-authored brief then #3334 refusal then stamp then verify) asserting both event kinds appear.

Relates #3323 (telemetry deliverable — shipped surface, unwired paths), #3334, #3282, #3320.
narratives.UserStory: As a telemetry consumer, I want acceptance_stamp and acceptance outcome events on every real path, so that field streams show whether derivation and the product AC gate actually ran.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src/scope and packages/core/src/intake, emit acceptance_stamp when plan.acceptance is first written or materially changed (promote/activate/verify), not only issue-ingest.ts. In packages/core/src/product-first-done-gate/evaluate.ts, emit an acceptance outcome on every product-AC-gate terminal path. Add a trial-shaped fixture. Do not edit run-summary lock/seq. Evidence command is the stated plan.acceptance command plus CHANGELOG #3355.
